elements.title: Figure C1.—Major Elements of Mineral-Resource Classification, Excluding Reserve Base and Inferred Reserve Base
elements.content:
A rectangular diagram divided into sections:
- Left column (vertical): Cumulative Production, ECONOMIC, MARGINALLY ECONOMIC, SUBECONOMIC, Other Occurrences
- Top row: IDENTIFIED RESOURCES and UNDISCOVERED RESOURCES
- Under IDENTIFIED RESOURCES: Demonstrated (Measured, Indicated), Inferred
- Under UNDISCOVERED RESOURCES: Probability Range (Hypothetical (or) Speculative)
- Middle section:
  - ECONOMIC: Reserves (Demonstrated), Inferred Reserves
  - MARGINALLY ECONOMIC: Marginal Reserves (Demonstrated), Inferred Marginal Reserves
  - SUBECONOMIC: Demonstrated Subeconomic Resources, Inferred Subeconomic Resources
  - UNDISCOVERED RESOURCES side has plus signs (+) in Hypothetical and Speculative columns
- Bottom box: Includes nonconventional and low-grade materials

elements.title: Figure C2.—Reserve Base and Inferred Reserve Base Classification Categories
elements.content:
A rectangular diagram divided into sections:
- Left column (vertical): Cumulative Production, ECONOMIC, MARGINALLY ECONOMIC, SUBECONOMIC, Other Occurrences
- Top row: IDENTIFIED RESOURCES and UNDISCOVERED RESOURCES
- Under IDENTIFIED RESOURCES: Demonstrated (Measured, Indicated), Inferred
- Under UNDISCOVERED RESOURCES: Probability Range (Hypothetical (or) Speculative)
- Middle section:
  - ECONOMIC and MARGINALLY ECONOMIC combined: Reserve Base (Demonstrated), Inferred Reserve Base
  - SUBECONOMIC: dashed line below Reserve Base
  - UNDISCOVERED RESOURCES side has plus signs (+) in Hypothetical and Speculative columns
- Bottom box: Includes nonconventional and low-grade materials
